# Derma Healer India

> Derma Healer is Siwan's premier skin, laser, aesthetic, and hair restoration clinic located in Bihar. Spearheaded by expert dermatologists, the clinic provides USFDA-approved medical treatments for laser tattoo removal, acne scars, laser hair removal, melasma, anti-aging, and hair loss.

## Core Services & Treatments

### Laser & Pigmentation Treatments
- [Laser Tattoo Removal](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/skin/tattoo-removal): Safe and precision removal of unwanted multi-colored tattoo ink using Q-Switched Nd:YAG laser technology.
- [Laser Hair Removal](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/hair/laser-hair-removal): Permanent USFDA-approved triple-wavelength diode laser reduction tailored for Indian skin types.
- [Melasma & Hyperpigmentation](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/skin/melasma): Customized clinical protocols, chemical peels, and laser therapy for stubborn dark spots and patches.
- [Carbon Laser Toning](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/face/carbon-laser-toning): Hollywood "carbon peel" laser treatment for deep skin cleansing, pore reduction, and instant skin brightening.

### Clinical Dermatology & Minor Surgeries
- [Acne & Scar Treatment](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/skin/acne): Complete medical care for active acne, cystic acne, and deep post-acne scarring using lasers and microneedling.
- [Vitiligo Surgery](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/skin/vitiligo): Surgical punch grafting and suction blister grafting options for restoring skin pigmentation in stable vitiligo patches.
- [Wart, Skin Tag & Xanthelasma Removal](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments): Radiofrequency electrosurgery and laser excision for skin tags, warts, and cholesterol deposits around eyes.

### Hair Loss & Restoration
- [PRP Hair Loss Therapy](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/hair/prp-therapy): Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy, mesotherapy, and growth factor treatments for hair regrowth and strengthening.

### Aesthetics & Advanced Anti-Aging
- [HIFU Facelift](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/body/body-hifu): Non-surgical high-intensity focused ultrasound for skin tightening, jawline contouring, and collagen production.
- [HydraFacial & Vampire Facial](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments): Clinical skin exfoliation, deep hydration, and microneedling with growth factors for youthful skin radiance.
- [Skin Boosters & Profhilo](https://dermahealerindia.com/treatments/skin/skin-boosters-profhilo): Pure hyaluronic acid bio-remodeling injections to reverse skin laxity and dryness.

## Key Doctors & Medical Leadership
- **Dr. B. K. Sharma (MBBS, MD - Skin & VD)** - Senior Dermatologist & Venereologist with 30+ years of clinical experience in clinical dermatology, vitiligo, and skin diseases.
- **Dr. Neha Rani (MBBS)** - Aesthetic Physician specializing in cosmetic laser therapies, anti-aging, and clinical hair restoration.
